caption: The drawing consists of eight square swatches arranged in two horizontal rows of four on a light beige background. Each square contains a unique textile or wallpaper pattern dominated by brown shades, with additional accents in red, green, blue, black, beige, and white. The top left square features a brown grid with small red, black, and white oval shapes. The second square in the top row contains a tan background with swirling lines and geometric motifs in gray, black, and red. The third square in the top row has a brown background with diagonal abstract dark and light markings, as well as scattered blue, red, and cream shapes. The fourth square hosts a light brown backdrop adorned with diagonal lines of red and green geometric leaf shapes. The bottom row starts with a square containing a brown surface patterned with floral motifs in cream, pink, and green, with outlined leaf shapes. The second square in the bottom row houses a dense, brown floral design, with white and yellow-green elements. The third square on the bottom row showcases a pattern of blue, red, and white flowers set among tan and brown abstract shapes, and the final square on the right is a brown background covered with blue, black, and cream abstract leaf or flower motifs. At the bottom right corner of the drawing, the word "ZIMET" is written in black.
title: Swatches from Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
